description: This file defines an abstract base class for Kubernetes adapters, intended for testing and extension purposes. It provides method signatures for applying manifests, waiting for jobs, and deleting resources, as well as functions for registering and retrieving adapter factory instances.

classes.name: BaseKubernetesAdapter
classes.description: An abstract base class for Kubernetes integration used during tests, defining asynchronous methods for applying manifests, waiting for jobs, and deleting resources.

methods.name: None apply_manifest(self, manifest: Dict[str, Any], namespace: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Asynchronously apply a Kubernetes manifest to a cluster.

methods.name: bool wait_for_job(self, name: str, namespace: str, timeout_seconds: int = 600)
methods.description: Asynchronously wait for a Kubernetes Job to complete, returning True if successful.

methods.name: None delete_resource(self, kind: str, name: str, namespace: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Asynchronously delete a specified Kubernetes resource by kind, name, and optional namespace.

methods.name: None set_kubernetes_adapter_factory(factory)
methods.description: Register a global factory function for creating Kubernetes adapter instances.

methods.name: Optional[BaseKubernetesAdapter] get_kubernetes_adapter()
methods.description: Retrieve a Kubernetes adapter instance if a factory has been registered, otherwise return None.

ctags.name: apply_manifest
ctags.pattern: /^    async def apply_manifest(self, manifest: Dict[str, Any], namespace: Optional[str] = None) ->/
ctags.signature: (self, manifest: Dict[str, Any], namespace: Optional[str] = None)

ctags.name: delete_resource
ctags.pattern: /^    async def delete_resource(self, kind: str, name: str, namespace: Optional[str] = None) -> No/
ctags.signature: (self, kind: str, name: str, namespace: Optional[str] = None)

ctags.name: wait_for_job
ctags.pattern: /^    async def wait_for_job(self, name: str, namespace: str, timeout_seconds: int = 600) -> bool:$/
ctags.signature: (self, name: str, namespace: str, timeout_seconds: int = 600)
